row.title: Five agent-interop roadmap items built by hand after model PRs stubbed them
row.body: MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation and server/discover, A2A v1 method aliases, a signed agent card with a Worker-held key and /.well-known/jwks.json, the connector_health tick step with a reconnect gate card (closing probe kind connector:<provider>), and /api/v1/agents/scoreboard. The tick skip-list text is asserted in seed/worker/test/tick.test.js, so a new step must be added there too.
